purpose.job: It says what the company exists for and what it will not do.

entries.text: Keep water in the pipe for fifty years.
entries.why: A leak behind a wall costs a family months.

mission.definition: Who the company serves, plus the offer.
mission.job: It tells staff which business the company is in.

entries.text: Copper pipes and fittings for plumbers who build new houses.
entries.why: It keeps the company out of repairs and retail.

vision.definition: The world the company wants to help build, and the company's role in it.
vision.job: It gives people something to aim at.

entries.text: Houses where nobody thinks about the pipes, and Alder made most of them.
entries.why: It names the role the company wants.

values.definition: Core values are beliefs the company already acts on and keeps at a cost.
values.job: It tells staff what to choose when the choice costs something.

entries.text: We test every fitting, even when the order is late.
entries.why: Testing costs a day on a rush order, and the company pays it.

way_of_winning.definition: The choices by which the company expects to beat competitors. Many documents call it the strategy.
way_of_winning.job: It names the choices the company makes and the ones it turns down.

entries.text: Win on fit the first time, at a higher price than cheaper brands. Sell through trade counters only.
entries.why: Plumbers pay more for a day saved.

audiences.definition: The people who must recognize the entity, and what each of them should think. Most documents call that thought the positioning.
audiences.job: It says who the brand is for and gives each audience its reasons to pick this brand.

entries.text: Plumbers who fit pipes in new houses.
entries.why: They pick the brand on site.

entries.text: Alder pipes fit the first time.
entries.why: A refit costs the plumber a day.

promise.job: It creates one clear expectation that the experience can keep or break.

personality.definition: The human traits the brand intends to show, in tone and in behavior.
personality.job: It makes the brand recognizable by its manner.

entries.text: Plain, practical and calm, like a good foreman.
entries.why: Plumbers trust people who talk like them.
entries.used_for: Every text and every phone call.

expressions.definition: Everything a person can sense that the entity intends to be recognized by: the name, the logo, the voice, the behaviors, the recognizable product features, a smell, a texture.
expressions.job: It lets people recognize the brand at once.

structure.definition: How the names of the company, its businesses and its products relate.
structure.job: It shows people which company stands behind which product.

entries.text: One brand, Alder Pipes. Products carry plain names such as Alder 15 mm elbow.
entries.why: One name is easier to ask for at a trade counter.

narrative.definition: The story the brand tells about itself: where it comes from, what it stands for and where it goes, told as one story.
narrative.job: It lets staff and partners tell the brand the same way.

entries.text: Alder started with one van in 1998, fixing leaks other pipes caused. It began to make pipes so it could stop fixing them.
entries.used_for: The about page and trade shows.

guidelines.definition: The rules for using the expressions: how the logo, the colors, the type, the pictures and the voice are applied.
guidelines.job: It lets everyone who makes something under the name apply the expressions the same way.
